name: Classic Shoyu Ramen
description: A traditional soy-sauce based ramen with tender chashu pork and a rich, savory broth.
instructions: 1. Prepare the shoyu broth. 2. Simmer the pork until tender. 3. Boil noodles. 4. Assemble the bowl with all toppings.

name: Spicy Miso Ramen
description: A bold and spicy miso ramen topped with corn, butter, and spicy minced pork.
instructions: 1. Mix miso paste with chili oil and water to create the base. 2. Cook noodles. 3. Top with corn, butter, and pork. 4. Serve with a piece of nori.

name: Tonkotsu Ramen
description: A creamy, milky white broth made by boiling pork bones for hours.
instructions: 1. Boil pork bones for 8-12 hours to create a creamy broth. 2. Season with garlic and ginger. 3. Serve with noodles and chashu.
